1.explanation: The provided code snippet demonstrates how images are currently being rendered without explicit width and height attributes. This setup can lead to layout shifts as the browser does not know the dimensions of the images beforehand. To reproduce the bug, you can run this code in an HTML environment and observe the layout shifts when the images load. The solution involves adding width and height attributes to each image element or using full-page screenshots as suggested in the bug report.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves image elements in a report that do not have explicit width and height attributes. This can lead to layout shifts and affect the Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) metric negatively. The images are currently hotlinked from a remote server, and the goal is to replace them with full-page screenshots to simplify content security policy (CSP) and mixed content issues.
